card.title: Cover Story Logistics
card.instruction: Accept that a secret plan exists, then focus on schedules, witnesses, explanations, cleanup, and what everyone must remember.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For Mum's surprise party, we're saying you brought the cake on the nine o'clock bus?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. She'll ask why she didn't see my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The last bus leaves at eight. Can you claim you walked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She drove past me at half eight. I was empty-handed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the cake was already here. We need Dad to remember accepting it before his nap.

mechanism: A treats a surprise-party cover account as a timetable and witness problem to make consistent.
confusable: Unlike inventing several mystery theories, A is deliberately constructing a shared explanation, checking it against known observations.
comparison: This alternative reconciles a cake alibi with transport and a sighting; the other coordinates a real group departure around the surprise recipient.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
